Maya T: Postmortem follow-up: we surfaced a recurring shard-rebalance pattern that spikes token latency and causes noisy alerts. I sketched 4 remediation items below. Please claim owners or propose reassignment. Target: have all Jira tickets linked + RACI filled by EOW Mon.

1) Shard rebalance smoothing (rate-limit reassigns) — goal: avoid 2x request amplification during rebalance windows. Suggest R/A: Aaron P, C: Eng-sre, I: Platform. Due 2026-04-10. Jira INF-9910
2) Transparent cache graceful-degrade (soft-fallback) — goal: graceful degrade to read-through when cache shard lost. R/A: Lena H, C: Runtime, I: Product. Due 2026-04-17. Jira INF-9911
3) Pager threshold consolidation — reduce duplicate pages for same root cause. R/A: Victor Z, C: Support, I: Eng leads. Due 2026-03-31. Jira INF-9912
4) Long-tail incident telemetry dash + alert correlation (detect recurrence) — R/A: Aaron P, C: Observability, I: SRE. Due 2026-04-24. Jira INF-9913

Maya T: Quick asks: reply with 'claim INF-xxxx' and add one measurable success criterion to the ticket (e.g., p95 latency < X during rebalance).

Aaron P: claim INF-9910 & INF-9913 — will own both since they're related. Planning: add token-level tracing for reassign window and a smoothing algorithm experiment. Need timeboxed spike test. ack.

Lena H: claim INF-9911. Will prototype read-through path and a feature flag for rollout. Pairing request to @Victor Z for integration testing.

Victor Z: claim INF-9912. I'll consolidate alerts and add unique incident fingerprinting to reduce dup pages. Can trial rule changes with Support next Wed.

Maya T: Nice. Small note: fill RACI custom fields in Jira (R/A/C/I) and add expected reviewer. Also add owner email for calendar invites for runbooks/tests.

Aaron P: question  for INF-9910  
- Do we want hard-rate limits or adaptive smoothing? My plan: experiment with adaptive smoothing first, fall back to hard-rate if unstable.

Lena H: adaptive sounds right to me. For INF-9911 we need an infra migration window to test read-through, pinging Platform to reserve a low-traffic slot.
